briefing_title: 日报总览：PHP 漏洞应急、AI 交易降温与中国政策密集发布
briefing_summary: 本期覆盖八个版面、共59篇。已发生事实包括：PHP 8.x 修复两个远程代码执行漏洞，利用已传播；OpenAI 与 Google Cloud 宣布将前沿模型和 Codex 工作流引入 Gemini 的 Model Garden；GitHub 称已将99.99999%仓库副本迁至 Azure。研究主张方面，Recursive 称 Flint 主要由其AI系统构建，多篇论文聚焦智能体评估与LLM服务；NASA 称毅力号累计行驶超过“机遇号”纪录。市场方面，科技股财报后AI交易受挫，中国股市势将进入熊市，铜价下跌，多国央行利率路径待观察；沃尔玛允许AI代理代购，亚马逊阻止。国际与国内动态包括基辅遭导弹袭击、朝鲜准备重启对韩宣传广播，以及中国发布“十五五”产业基础规划、海洋GDP超11万亿元、黑龙江秋收近九成。观点版面关注 EA 关闭 BioWare、Meta 在新墨西哥州案中被判罚250亿美元等报道。
briefing_title_en: Daily Briefing: PHP Vulnerability Response, AI Trade Pullback and China Policy Moves
briefing_summary_en: An eight-section briefing covering 59 articles. Confirmed: PHP 8.x patched two RCE flaws with exploits circulating; OpenAI and Google Cloud announced frontier models and Codex workflows in Gemini's Model Garden; GitHub said it moved copies of 99.99999% of repositories to Azure. Research claims: Recursive said Flint was largely built by its AI system; arXiv papers address agent evaluation and LLM serving; NASA said Perseverance surpassed Opportunity's driving record. Markets: tech earnings failed to reassure the AI trade, Chinese stocks headed toward a bear market, copper fell, and central-bank paths remained uncertain; Walmart allows AI-agent purchases while Amazon blocks them. Also: Kyiv missile strikes, North Korea propaganda loudspeakers, China's industrial-base plan and ocean GDP, EA closing BioWare, and Meta's reported $25B New Mexico penalty.

articles.summary_en: The paper examines whether multi-agent LLM collaboration reduces hallucination in clinical tasks, distinguishing performance gains from claims of greater trustworthiness in stated reasoning.
articles.original_title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
articles.reason: 直接检验多智能体协作与临床幻觉的关系，涉及安全与可信评估。

articles.summary: 论文提出 MAMath-Bench，用于评估多模态多智能体系统的数学推理，不仅看答案正确性，也考察推理过程是否连贯、可验证。
articles.title_en: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
articles.summary_en: MAMath-Bench is a benchmark for multimodal multi-agent mathematical reasoning that evaluates not only final answers but also whether reasoning processes are coherent and verifiable.
articles.original_title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
articles.reason: 提出新的多模态多智能体数学推理基准，强调过程评估与稳健性。
articles.reason_en: Introduces a new benchmark for multimodal multi-agent mathematical reasoning, emphasizing process evaluation and robustness.

articles.title: SkillEval：通过认知诊断模型学习 LLM 的可解释能力画像
articles.summary: 针对基准评测将表现聚合成单一分数的粗粒度问题，SkillEval 利用认知诊断模型，从基准数据中学习 LLM 可解释的技能能力画像。
articles.title_en: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
articles.summary_en: SkillEval uses cognitive diagnosis models to learn interpretable skill profiles of LLMs from benchmark data, moving beyond single scalar scores that ignore the range of skills tested.
articles.original_title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
articles.reason: 提出细粒度 LLM 能力评估方法，直接回应基准评测单一分数的问题。
articles.reason_en: Proposes a fine-grained LLM ability evaluation method that directly addresses single-score benchmark aggregation.

articles.title: SANE：面向 LLM 评判器的自动化评分器专属蜕变测试
articles.summary: 论文提出 SANE，针对 LLM 评判器在基准评估、模型选择和数据筛选中的可靠性，自动生成与其评分标准相关的蜕变测试。
articles.title_en: SANE: Automated Scorer-Specific Metamorphic Testing for LLM Judges
articles.summary_en: SANE introduces automated scorer-specific metamorphic testing for LLM judges, checking whether each judge responds reliably to input changes that affect its scoring criterion.
articles.original_title: SANE: Automated Scorer-Specific Metamorphic Testing for LLM Judges
articles.reason: 关注 LLM 评判器可靠性测试，属于评估方法与治理工具研究。
articles.reason_en: Focuses on reliability testing for LLM judges, relevant to evaluation methods and governance tooling.

articles.title: 多智能体协作能减少临床任务中的幻觉吗？
articles.summary: 论文区分多智能体 LLM 在临床任务上性能提升与系统更可信两种主张，考察协作是否减少幻觉，以及这对临床推理意味着什么。
articles.title_en: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
articles.summary_en: The paper examines whether multi-agent LLM collaboration reduces hallucination in clinical tasks, distinguishing performance gains from claims of greater trustworthiness in stated reasoning.
articles.original_title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
articles.reason: 直接检验多智能体协作与临床幻觉的关系，涉及安全与可信评估。
articles.reason_en: Directly examines the link between multi-agent collaboration and clinical hallucination, relevant to safety and trust evaluation.

articles.title: LIFT：用于评估与训练指令遵循的作用域约束
articles.summary: 论文提出 LIFT，用作用域约束评估和训练语言模型的指令遵循能力，以应对现有简单约束基准可能引发奖励黑客的问题。
articles.title_en: LIFT: Scoped Constraints for Evaluating and Training Instruction Following
articles.summary_en: LIFT proposes scoped constraints for evaluating and training instruction following, addressing reward hacking risks in benchmarks that use easily verifiable simple constraints.
articles.original_title: LIFT: Scoped Constraints for Evaluating and Training Instruction Following
articles.reason: 提出新的指令遵循评估与训练约束，针对奖励黑客风险。
articles.reason_en: Introduces new scoped constraints for instruction-following evaluation and training, targeting reward hacking risks.

subsections.briefing_title: 研究与治理：从多智能体数学推理到 LLM 评判器测试
subsections.briefing_summary: MAMath-Bench 不仅评估多模态多智能体系统的最终答案，也考察推理过程是否连贯、可验证；SkillEval 利用认知诊断模型从基准数据中学习 LLM 的可解释技能画像；SANE 自动生成评分器专属蜕变测试，以检查 LLM 评判器对影响其评分标准的输入变化是否可靠响应。另有论文区分多智能体 LLM 在临床任务上的性能提升与可信度主张，考察协作是否减少幻觉；LIFT 则用作用域约束评估和训练指令遵循，以应对简单约束基准可能引发的奖励黑客问题。
subsections.briefing_title_en: Research and Governance: From Multi-Agent Math Reasoning to LLM Judge Testing
subsections.briefing_summary_en: MAMath-Bench evaluates multimodal multi-agent mathematical reasoning not only by final answers but also by whether reasoning processes are coherent and verifiable. SkillEval uses cognitive diagnosis models to learn interpretable skill profiles of LLMs from benchmark data. SANE automatically generates scorer-specific metamorphic tests to check whether LLM judges respond reliably to input changes affecting their scoring criteria. Another paper distinguishes performance gains from trustworthiness claims for multi-agent LLMs in clinical tasks and examines whether collaboration reduces hallucination, while LIFT uses scoped constraints for evaluating and training instruction following to address reward hacking risks in simple-constraint benchmarks.

articles.title: 研究改写 1848 年太阳风暴致列车延误事件

articles.title_en: A train was delayed by a solar storm. But something didn't add up.

articles.title_en: Too much RNA can starve cells of energy, scientists discover

articles.reason_en: Presents space-medicine findings from 13 astronauts on heart adaptation to weightlessness and simulated Martian gravity.

articles.title_en: Rejuvenation breakthrough: Scientists reverse 60 years of aging in human cells
articles.summary_en: Scientists converted blood cells from an 80-year-old into neural stem cells with a molecular age under 20, reversing more than 60 years of cellular aging in the lab and offering a new way to study age-related disease.

articles.reason_en: Reports a concrete lab result: blood cells from an 80-year-old reprogrammed into neural stem cells with molecular age under 20.
